# Importer ZIP extraction reports completion without proving every file extracted

BaseProfileImporter.extractZipFile resolves to a temporary directory and reports progress through a callback. The UI awaits it and maps extraction to the first20percent before backend import. The helper logs per-file extraction failures and continues, then reports1 and returns the directory. Resolution and final progress therefore do not establish complete file extraction. New tests check layout, selected-root ignore behavior and progress bounds, using fake files; they do not exercise extraction failures or cleanup. The async return documentation should be read against the awaited caller contract. No archive operation or test ran.

Scope: BaseProfileImporter extraction completion and progress contract.
